version: 0.15.1
date: 2026-11-03

### Changed

- Change dependencies to their latest non-major versions: new sites start on Nuxt 4.6.3, which fixes a security issue where dot segments in a request path bypass server middleware and route rules (GHSA-9v7c-q64q-vv33), and the packages require `@nuxt/kit` 4.6.3, `shiki` 4.6 and current icon sets. Existing sites should update `nuxt` to 4.6.3 too. ([#100](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/100))
- Change the hosted platform's sign-in to Better Auth 1.7.12 (through `@lupinum/better-convex-nuxt` 1.0.0-rc.8): stricter checks of the sign-in token keys, current cookie rules and safer account flows. Sign-in with an email code works as before. ([#101](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/101))

### Fixed

- Fix missing pages showing raw JSON on Vercel: when curl, a monitor or a bot requested a missing address first, the page cache kept Nuxt's JSON error and served it to every browser. A cached address now always answers an error with the site's error page as HTML; `/api/`, `.json` addresses and `/__ginko/` keep Nuxt's choice. ([#99](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/99))
- Fix cramped task sheets in the Studio on large screens: the sheet now grows with the screen (up to 60rem), and a field shows the main-language text beside its input only when the field itself is wide enough ([#96](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/issues/96)). ([#99](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/99))

### Other

- Make `NUXT_PUBLIC_GINKO_NOINDEX=true` work on sites with the Nuxt SEO modules. `@nuxtjs/robots` writes robots.txt and the robots header there, and Ginko told it only about preview hosts, so a demo on its own address stayed indexable. Ginko now marks every host of such a deployment as not indexable in nuxt-site-config. ([#94](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/94))
